full_text: DILG DACONO PILIP'NAS Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www, OPINION NO. S. MAR 0 3 2025 ATTY. ALFREDO J. SIPALAY Counsel for Mr. Bimbo C. Ramos Cabrera Sipalay Bacalso & Maylon Law Offices 206 Aniceta Building, Osmena Blvd. Capitol Site, Cebu Cityy Dear Atty. Sipalay: This has reference to your request for this Department's opinion on whether or not a duly elected Sangguniang Barangay who was imprisoned from April 9, 2019, until his acquittal on April 29, 2024 is still entitled to honorarium as member of the Sangguniang Barangay. Per the letter, your client, Mr. Bimbo C. Ramos, a duly elected member of the Sangguniang Barangay of Barangay Lawaan III, Talisay City Cebu who was arrested on April 9, 2019 for alleged violation of RA 9165, otherwise known as the Dangerous Drugs Act of 2022. You then represented that he was acquitted on April 26, 2024 by RTC-Branch 66, Talisay City. This Department have already rendered an opinion on the same subject matter in DILG Opinion No. 55 series of 2004. In the said opinion, we opined that barangay officials are not entitled to the payment of the monthly honorarium in the absence of the required actual services rendered. Attached is a copy of the said opinion for your ready reference. This opinion is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated in your letter and our appreciation of the same. We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. ROMEO p.
